David_1: son of Jesse (Ruth 4:17), King of Israel (2 Samuel 5:3)
Saul_1: son of Kish (1 Samuel 9:2), King of Israel (1 Samuel 11:15)
Abishai_1: son of Zeruiah and Joab's brother (1 Samuel 26:6), chief of "the thirty" of David's men (2 Samuel 23:18)
Zeruiah_1: mother of Abishai, Joab (1 Samuel 26:6), and Asahel (2 Samuel 2:18), sister of King David (1 Chronicles 2:16)
Absalom_1: third-born son of King David (2 Samuel 3:3)
Ziba_1: servant from the house of Saul (2 Samuel 9:2)
Ahithophel_1: David's counselor, the Gilonite (2 Samuel 15:12, 1 Chronicles 27:32)
Hushai_1: the Archite (2 Samuel 15:32), David's friend (1 Chronicles 27:33)
Shimei_2: of the house of Saul (2 Samuel 16:5) who threw stones at King David
Gera_3: father of Shimei (2 Samuel 16:5), son of Bela (1 Chronicles 8:5)
